stem: Which question is explicitly included in the pGALS musculoskeletal screening questions?

options.text: Do you have any pain or stiffness in your joints, muscles, or back?
Do you wake every night with bone pain
Have you had any recent fevers with limping
Can you run as fast as your classmates
Have you noticed swelling in the small joints of your hands

explanation: The correct answer is the question about pain or stiffness in the joints, muscles, or back. This is one of the explicitly listed pGALS screening questions for musculoskeletal symptoms.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: The pGALS Musculoskeletal Screen

rationale: pGALS includes a direct symptom screen asking about pain or stiffness in the joints, muscles, or back.

optionExplanations.A: Correct because this is an explicitly listed pGALS screening question.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because night bone pain is not one of the pGALS screening questions.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because fever with limping is clinically relevant but not one of the listed pGALS screening questions.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because this assesses exercise performance rather than the pGALS symptom screen.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because hand joint swelling is not one of the explicitly listed pGALS screening questions.
